fallbackInspectDescription: Interactive control in the dashboard. Hover in explain-controls mode to identify what it does before you click it.

toggle-inspect-mode.label: Explain controls mode
toggle-inspect-mode.description: Highlights every interactive control and shows a tooltip that explains what it does when you hover or focus it.

toggle-value-inspect-mode.label: Explain values mode
toggle-value-inspect-mode.description: Highlights live values and shows a tooltip that explains where each value comes from.

toggle-reality-inspect-mode.label: Show real vs mock mode
toggle-reality-inspect-mode.description: Highlights the current view by implementation truth so real wiring, mock behavior, and mixed areas are easy to spot.

toggle-backend-status-inspect-mode.label: Show backend status mode
toggle-backend-status-inspect-mode.description: Highlights whether a section is backed by a real backend, frontend-only mock behavior, or missing backend support.

clear-history.label: Clear event history
clear-history.description: Removes the sidebar event history list and replaces it with a fresh "History cleared" entry.

copy-history.label: Copy event history
copy-history.description: Copies the current sidebar event history state to the clipboard as formatted JSON.

verify-env.label: Verify .env
verify-env.description: Calls the init endpoint that checks whether the required environment variables and config keys are present.

check-db.label: Check database status
check-db.description: Requests a database health/status summary without modifying the SQLite file.

inspect-db.label: Inspect database
inspect-db.description: Fetches a deeper inspection payload for the configured SQLite database so the operator can review its current state.

delete-db.label: Delete database
delete-db.description: Deletes the configured SQLite database and related sidecar files after a confirmation prompt.

recreate-db.label: Recreate database
recreate-db.description: Deletes the current SQLite file if needed, recreates it, and bootstraps canonical schema tables from schema.sql after confirmation.

select-scheduler-target-windows.label: Select Windows scheduler target
select-scheduler-target-windows.description: Selects the Windows CronEmulator target and disables the Raspberry crontab controls.

select-scheduler-target-raspberry.label: Select Raspberry scheduler target
select-scheduler-target-raspberry.description: Selects the Raspberry real-crontab target and disables the Windows CronEmulator controls.

install-cron.label: Install scheduler
install-cron.description: Installs or updates the platform scheduler target used by the repo-local scheduler host.

check-cron.label: Check scheduler
check-cron.description: Reads scheduler status so the operator can verify whether the scheduled job is present and healthy.

print-cron.label: Print scheduler
print-cron.description: Prints the scheduler/task definition details returned by the backend for inspection.

verify-db-viewer.label: Verify database
verify-db-viewer.description: Checks whether the configured SQLite file exists and whether the documented required-table baseline is present.

connect-db-viewer.label: Connect to database
connect-db-viewer.description: Calls the logical backend connect gate used by View E before catalog and row reads are enabled.

show-db-tables.label: Show tables
show-db-tables.description: Loads the current list of non-system tables and views from the SQLite helper backend.

start-db-logging.label: Start DB logging
start-db-logging.description: Starts a bounded backend logging session that captures repo-local DB actions observed by this app.

stop-db-logging.label: Stop DB logging
stop-db-logging.description: Stops the current bounded DB logging session and reveals the captured backend activity entries.

run-b1.label: Run login flow
run-b1.description: Calls the backend auth preflight endpoints for status, run, reset, 2FA submit, and logout while rendering only the safe public auth projection.

test-b1-login-download-one.label: Test login download
test-b1-login-download-one.description: Calls the backend auth test endpoint that uses icloudpd and .env credentials to download one recent item into runtime_data/tmp when authentication is already usable.

run-b2.label: Run download test action
run-b2.description: Calls the backend download endpoint and reports the response in the B2 log.

run-b3-auto.label: Run all pipeline stages
run-b3-auto.description: Calls the backend orchestration endpoint for the B3 auto-run path while leaving individual stage buttons separate.

run-b3-1.label: Run download stage
run-b3-1.description: Calls the backend download stage endpoint from the pipeline view.

run-b3-2.label: Run index stage
run-b3-2.description: Calls the backend index stage endpoint from the pipeline view.

run-b3-3.label: Run GPS parsing
run-b3-3.description: Simulates GPS extraction for indexed media in the staged pipeline.

run-b3-4.label: Run geocode stage
run-b3-4.description: Calls the backend geocode stage. The geocoder here is a deterministic placeholder implementation that converts coordinates into a pseudo‑location string; this is not a real geocoding provider.

run-b3-5.label: Prepare playback queue
run-b3-5.description: Calls the backend queue-prepare endpoint so playback selection can use real queue rows.

detect-pipeline-issues.label: Detect pipeline issues
detect-pipeline-issues.description: Calls the backend pipeline diagnostic endpoint and currently reports stale persisted pipeline locks only.

clear-stale-pipeline-locks.label: Clear stale pipeline locks
clear-stale-pipeline-locks.description: Calls the backend stale-lock cleanup endpoint, which clears only stale persisted pipeline locks and leaves fresh active locks unchanged.

run-b4.label: Select current playback item
run-b4.description: Calls the backend playback-selection endpoint and updates the operator preview with the selected item.

resume-last-run.label: Resume from saved state
resume-last-run.description: Triggers the placeholder recovery action that stands in for a future resume-from-checkpoint flow.

refresh-last-run.label: Refresh last run
refresh-last-run.description: Calls the backend orchestration last-run endpoint and updates the read-only View C summary.

start-real-run.label: Start simulated runtime preview
start-real-run.description: Activates the D-view worker preview so the pipeline, playback, and screen monitor cards begin updating.

none.label: Show no-run demo
none.description: Switches the recovery panel to the empty state where no saved run is available.

error.label: Show error demo
error.description: Switches the recovery panel to an error state that mimics a failed source-of-truth read.

ready.label: Show ready demo
ready.description: Loads the seeded last-run demo so the recovery layout shows realistic saved-run data.

currentTruthValueSources.Source of truth: state.truth.sourceOfTruth, seeded from conf/runtime-truth.json and then kept in sync to that file during runtime truth updates.
currentTruthValueSources.Queue length: state.truth.queueLength, updated by queue-stage actions and demo-state seeding.
currentTruthValueSources.Current media: state.truth.currentMedia, populated when media is queued or demo state is loaded.
currentTruthValueSources.Playback status: state.truth.playbackStatus, updated by playback runs, screen simulation, and demo seeding.
currentTruthValueSources.Screen state: state.truth.screenState, updated by screen-simulation toggles and runtime preview state changes.
currentTruthValueSources.Last activity: state.truth.lastActivitySource, derived from the currently enabled simulated activity inputs.
currentTruthValueSources.Timeout: state.truth.inactivityTimeoutSeconds, updated from the B5 inactivity timeout input.
currentTruthValueSources.Last checkpoint: state.truth.lastCheckpoint, updated by playback and screen checkpoint events.
currentTruthValueSources.Last stage: state.truth.lastStageCompleted, updated when pipeline stages complete.
currentTruthValueSources.Stage lock: state.truth.stageLock, updated when pipeline lock ownership changes.
currentTruthValueSources.Playback lock: state.truth.playbackLock, updated when playback emulation or runtime preview acquires the worker lock.
currentTruthValueSources.Screen lock: state.truth.screenLock, updated when the simulated runtime preview acquires the screen worker lock.

select-scheduler-target-raspberry.reason: Calls the live scheduler target-selection endpoint and updates the active 3A target.

B.reason: The Test view is explicitly simulation-only in the current repo.

C.reason: The Last Run view reads backend orchestration last-run data, but restore remains placeholder behavior.

E.reason: The Database Viewer uses live backend routes for verification, table reads, rows, and session logging, while still living inside the shared hybrid dashboard shell.

start-real-run.reason: This starts a simulated runtime preview because the real runtime backend/worker API is not implemented here.

logEntry.label: Open log entry details
logEntry.description: Opens the selected log entry so you can inspect its timestamps, action metadata, and any captured request/response payloads.

historyEntry.label: Open history event details
historyEntry.description: Opens the selected history item so you can inspect its timeline and any captured context fields.

inactivityTimeout.label: Set inactivity timeout
inactivityTimeout.description: Changes how many seconds of inactivity B5 waits before the screen simulation flips to OFF and updates the checkpoint state.

inspectCopy.dbTableDescription: Loads the selected table from the live database viewer backend and shows its bounded rows in E3.

dbPageDescriptions.previous: Requests another backend-owned page of rows for the currently selected database object.
dbPageDescriptions.next: Requests another backend-owned page of rows for the currently selected database object.

auto.label: Execution mode: auto pipeline
auto.description: B3 runs the full pipeline sequence automatically when you trigger the main auto-run control.

manual.label: Execution mode: manual pipeline
manual.description: B3 is configured for one-stage-at-a-time operation so each stage can be triggered individually.

single.label: Mock input mode: one file at a time
single.description: Runs the mock download flow in a single-file mode so stage outputs are easier to inspect step by step.

all.label: Mock input mode: all files
all.description: Represents a future all-files mode. It stays disabled in the current prototype.

pirEnabled.label: Toggle PIR sensor activity
pirEnabled.description: Controls whether the motion-sensor activity source counts as active in the backend-owned B5 screen simulation.

mouseEnabled.label: Toggle mouse activity
mouseEnabled.description: Controls whether mouse movement counts as an activity source that keeps the backend-owned simulated screen awake.

keyboardEnabled.label: Toggle keyboard activity
keyboardEnabled.description: Controls whether keyboard activity counts as a wake/keep-awake signal in the backend-owned B5 simulation.

simulateAllEnabled.label: Toggle all activity sources
simulateAllEnabled.description: Turns the major simulated activity sources on or off together so the screen state can be tested quickly.
